3. Booking commands & saga (write side)
item.description: RUN THIS FOLDER WITH THE COLLECTION RUNNER (not request by request) so the polling requests can loop. Order matters: the bookingId created in step 1 is reused by the later requests.

request.description: RBAC: needs role CUSTOMER/ADMIN. ABAC: tenantId must equal the token's tenant_id and user_location must be allowed (IN, TH, MY, VN, AE). Writes bookings + 2 outbox rows (BOOKING_CREATED, PAYMENT_REQUESTED) in ONE transaction.

Flow: Debezium -> topic booking-payment -> payment-saga-service (simulated approval) -> outbox booking-saga -> Debezium -> booking-command-service sets CONFIRMED + BOOKING_CONFIRMED event -> topic booking -> query service upserts booking_read_model.

exec: setTimeout(function () {}, 2000); // wait 2 s between polls (Debezium + Kafka latency)
console.log("Not yet " + expected + " (got " + status + ", HTTP " + pm.response.code + "). Retry " + (n + 1));
pm.test("read model reached CONFIRMED (CDC -> Kafka -> projection)", () => pm.expect(status).to.eql(expected));

item.name: 3.14 Admin may create for any tenant (ABAC bypass) -> 201
4. Resilience: retry topics + DLT (needs payment service restarted - see guide)
item.description: Restart payment-saga-service with PAYMENT_SIMULATE=false and PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:9 so every gateway call fails. Circuit breaker fallback returns DEFERRED -> PaymentUnavailableException -> 3 exponential Kafka retries (1 s, 2 s, 4 s) -> booking-payment.DLT -> compensation PAYMENT_FAILED.

exec: pm.test("201 Created (command side accepts regardless of payment health)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

request.description: Takes ~10-25 s: resilience4j retries (3 x 500 ms+) per Kafka attempt, then retry topics, then DLT.

exec: setTimeout(function () {}, 2000); // wait 2 s between polls (Debezium + Kafka latency)
console.log("Not yet " + expected + " (got " + status + ", HTTP " + pm.response.code + "). Retry " + (n + 1));
pm.test("read model reached PAYMENT_FAILED (CDC -> Kafka -> projection)", () => pm.expect(status).to.eql(expected));

item.name: 5. Gateway rate limiting (token bucket)
item.description: Run this folder in the Runner with 250 iterations and 0 ms delay. Booking route: replenishRate 50/s, burstCapacity 100.

request.description: Expect the first ~100 calls to return 200 and later ones 429 when sent faster than 50 req/s.

exec: pm.test("200 OK or 429 Too Many Requests", () => pm.expect([200, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code));
console.log("Rate limited - token bucket is working");
